title: Tool catalog entry
description: features/<stack>/tools/<tool>/meta.json — an external CLI tool's identity, what must be installed for it, and which agents it can hook. The marker index_build.py keys the tools discovery rule on. Its prose lives beside it in tool.md. Which projects use it is config.tools; the file each harness writes is owned by that agent's adjust_tools.py, not recorded here.

name.description: The tool name, matching the directory name and the key config.tools uses.

package.description: Distribution name for install reference (Homebrew, crates.io).

description.description: What the tool is, for a human reading the catalog. tool.md is what reaches a session.

prerequisite.description: What must already be on the machine for the tool's hooks to do anything.

summary.description: What has to be installed, in a phrase a reader can act on, including any version floor.

check.description: A command that exits 0 when the prerequisite is present.

install.description: Where to get it — an install URL or the exact command.

hooks.description: The agents this tool can hook, keyed by agent. native: ai-badger writes the hook itself; init: ai-badger runs the tool's own installer in the project; propose: ai-badger only prints the command for the user.

arg.description: The tool's own name for this agent, passed to its hook or init command.
